Everything here is in English apart from one Hebrew line, so I'll keep the English: the finance names are all English and I'm struggling to read them letter by letter. The Hebrew line is unclear to me, and the grey text beneath it is hard to read, so I'll check one more screen before I stop.

The same text appears again, with a small note at the bottom saying the page is personal and non-commercial with no marketing links, which is reassuring. But I still haven't found which bank is cheaper, so I'll keep looking.
